entities.summary: Cameron Forbes Kerry is an American attorney and policy researcher known for his work on privacy, cross-border data flows, and artificial intelligence governance. He is a distinguished visiting fellow at the Brookings Institution. He previously served as general counsel and acting Secretary of the U.S. Department of Commerce.
